front_panel_classes.evidence: A plain numeric control: NI's hierarchy lists Digital beside NamedNumeric and NumericWithScale (Slide, Knob), which are the front-panel classes stdRing, stdSlide and stdKnob; no other class is left for stdNum.
A ring control: NI's hierarchy lists Ring under NamedNumeric; the type is a ring (no enum labels in the type).

An enum control is stored as stdRing with an enum type; the corpus VI Is Enum Control.vi (measurement-plugin-labview) reads ClassID and takes case 35 to cast the reference to an enum control, and NI's ClassID table gives 35 as Enum.
NI's hierarchy lists Boolean under Control.
NI's hierarchy lists String under Control.

NI's hierarchy lists Cluster under Control; an error cluster is a cluster.
NI's hierarchy lists Array under Control.
NI's hierarchy lists ComboBox under String.

display_names.name: Color Box

display_names.name: Time Stamp
display_names.evidence: NI's hierarchy lists AbsTime (the absolute-time class); NI's manual calls the control a Time Stamp control (Configuring the Time and Date in a Time Stamp Control, https://www.ni.com/docs/en-US/bundle/labview/page/configuring-the-time-and-date-in-a-time-stamp-control.html). The render draws absTime as a Timestamp (controls/timestamp.py).

display_names.name: Graph or Chart
display_names.evidence: NI's hierarchy lists the graph and chart classes (WaveformChart, WaveformGraph, XYGraph, DigitalGraph, IntensityChart, IntensityGraph, MixedSignalGraph) under one parent, GraphChart (ClassID 22, GraphOrChart). The saved control records one class, stdGraph, for them and nothing else in the file that tells which, so the common NI parent is named.
